문장을 처음부터 한 단어씩 차례로 읽지 않아도, 번역을 잘할 수 있을까?: Can a model translate well without reading a sentence one word at a time, from start to finish?
2017년까지 번역 모델은 문장을 한 단어씩 순서대로 읽는 순환 신경망이: Until 2017, translation models centered on recurrent neural networks that read a sentence one word at a time, in order. This paper removed recurrence entirely and built a translator using only attention, in which every word “highlights and consults” every other word all at once. The result was higher translation scores and much shorter training time.

\"어텐션\"은 이름만 사람의 주의에서 빌렸어요. 사람이 집중하는 방식과: “Attention” only borrows the name from human attention. It does not mean the model focuses the way people do.
<b>순환을 빼고 어텐션만 쓴다.</b> 모든 단어가 다른 모든 단어를: Remove recurrence and use attention only. Every word consults every other word at once. The path between distant words becomes a single step, and computation within a sentence can run all at once. The paper called this “the first transduction model relying entirely on attention.”

Memory box (imitating an RNN): a box with one slot per symbol. At each step, every slot is multiplied by λ and (1−λ) is added to the current symbol's slot. The symbol right after ★ is written at 3× (since it is known to be important). At the end, the largest slot is the answer.

단어를 하나씩 읽으며 이전 상태 hₜ₋₁과 지금 입력으로 새 상태 hₜ를: A model that reads words one by one and creates a new state hₜ from the previous state hₜ₋₁ and the current input.
A recurrent neural network built with gates so that it keeps memory for longer.
합성곱으로 모든 자리를 병렬 계산하는 번역 모델. 먼 두 자리를 잇는 연: A translation model that computes all positions in parallel using convolutions. The number of operations needed to connect two distant positions grows with the distance.
A computation that sets weights by how well queries and keys match, then takes a weighted average of the values with those weights.
Attention in which every position in a sentence consults every position in that same sentence.
softmax(QKᵀ/√dₖ)V. 내적을 √dₖ로 나눠 소프트맥스 포화를: softmax(QKᵀ/√dₖ)V. Dividing the dot product by √dₖ prevents softmax saturation.
Attention that computes the match between a query and a key with a neural network having one hidden layer.
질의·키·값을 h개의 작은 공간으로 사영해 여러 어텐션을 동시에 돌리고: A method that projects queries, keys, and values into h smaller spaces, runs several attentions at once, and concatenates the results.
질의(무엇을 찾나), 키(각 자리의 꼬리표), 값(가져올 정보) 세 벡터: Three vectors: the query (what is being sought), the key (each position's tag), and the value (the information to retrieve).
A function that turns scores into probabilities between 0 and 1 that sum to 1.
점수가 너무 커져 한 곳에 거의 1이 몰리고 기울기가 아주 작아지는 상태: A state where scores grow so large that nearly all the weight lands on one spot and the gradient becomes very small.
자리마다 서로 다른 주기의 sin·cos 값을 임베딩에 더해 순서 정보를: A method that adds sine and cosine values with a different period for each position to the embeddings, injecting order information.
A method that learns a vector for each position and adds it.
토큰을 d_model차원 벡터로 바꾼 것. 트랜스포머는 입력·출력 임베딩: Converting a token into a d_model-dimensional vector. The Transformer shares weights between the input embedding, the output embedding, and the output layer.
입력을 연속 표현으로 바꾸는 인코더와 그 표현으로 출력을 한 기호씩 만드: An encoder structure that turns the input into continuous representations, and a decoder structure that produces the output one symbol at a time from those representations.

Each token gets a 512-dimensional vector (embedding), multiplied by √512. The input embedding, the output embedding, and the final linear layer share the same weight matrix.
임베딩과 같은 512차원의 사인·코사인 값을 더해 \"몇 번째 자리인지\: Adds sine and cosine values of 512 dimensions, the same size as the embedding, to encode “which position is this.” Dropout 0.1 is applied to this sum as well.
인코더 한 층 = 여러 색 형광펜(셀프 어텐션) → 단어별 작은 신경망(: One encoder layer = multicolor highlighters (self-attention) → per-word mini network (512→2048→512). Each step is wrapped in a shortcut of the form LayerNorm(x + Sublayer(x)) with layer normalization. The same layer is stacked 6 times.
디코더 한 층 = 가림막을 친 셀프 어텐션(뒤쪽 단어를 −∞로 가림) →: One decoder layer = self-attention with a mask (later words hidden with −∞) → attention that consults the reading tower's result (queries from the decoder, keys and values from the encoder output) → per-word mini network. 한 문장 안의 모든 자리가 같은 문장의 모든 자리를 참고하는 어텐션. 논: Attention in which every position in a sentence consults every position in that same sentence. The paper's name for it is self-attention; it is also called intra-attention.
질의와 키가 얼마나 맞는지로 가중치를 정하고, 그 가중치로 값들을 가중: A computation that sets weights by how well queries and keys match, then takes a weighted average of the values with those weights. It only borrows its name from human attention.
The vector holding “what is being sought.” This page's nickname is question card.
Converts the scores with eˣ and divides by their sum. Results lie between 0 and 1 and sum to 1.
Multiply the same-position entries of two vectors and add up all the products. The more the directions match, the larger it is.
The number of dimensions of the key (and query) vectors. The paper's base model uses 64.
어텐션을 h개의 작은 공간에서 동시에 계산해 이어 붙이는 것. 이 페이지: Computes attention simultaneously in h smaller spaces and concatenates the results. This page's nickname is multicolor highlighters.
Adds a different sine and cosine value for each position to the embedding, injecting order information. Nickname: position wave stamp.
Converting a token into a fixed-length numeric vector. The paper uses 512 dimensions.
여러 계산을 차례로 하지 않고 동시에 돌리는 것. GPU가 빨라지는 핵심: Running many computations at once instead of one after another. The key condition for GPUs to speed things up.
A model that reads words one at a time and creates a new state from the previous state and the current input. LSTM is the representative example.
기계 번역이 사람 번역과 단어 조각(n-gram)을 얼마나 겹치게 썼는지: A score measuring how much the word pieces (n-grams) of a machine translation overlap with a human translation. Higher is better.

<b>순서대로 읽어야 문장을 안다.</b> 순환 신경망(RNN, LSTM: You have to read in order to understand a sentence. Recurrent neural networks (RNN, LSTM) read words one by one and rewrite a memory box hₜ. Because hₜ can only be computed after hₜ₋₁ finishes, the computation within one sentence cannot be split up (parallelization). Attention was already in use, but mostly as an add-on to recurrent networks.
단어마다 질의(질문 카드), 키(색인표), 값(내용)을 만든다. 질의와: For each word, create a query (question card), a key (index tag), and a value (content). Take the dot product of the query with each key, divide by √dₖ, convert with softmax into weights that sum to 1, then take a weighted average of the values.
질의·키·값을 h번 서로 다른 학습된 사영으로 dₖ = d<sub>mod: Queries, keys, and values are each projected h times with different learned projections down to dₖ = d<sub>model</sub>/h dimensions. Then multiple heads compute attention simultaneously, and their results are concatenated and projected again. The paper uses h = 8 and dₖ = dᵥ = 64.
순환도 합성곱도 없으니 순서 정보를 따로 넣어야 한다. 단어 임베딩에 같: With no recurrence and no convolution, order information must be added separately. A positional encoding of the same size is added to each word embedding. For each dimension, these are sines and cosines whose wavelengths grow geometrically from 2π up to 10000·2π.
